title: Tempest Lull
summary: A palm-sized, one-piece storm-cloud relief that rocks on a crescent keel while its lightning jewel sweeps through the open rain arch.
print_process: Support-free FDM, 0.4 mm nozzle, keel-down orientation
interaction: Nudge either cloud cheek; the body rocks through a gravity-return cycle and the fixed bolt traces a visible side-to-side arc.
